liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Terrapin had several moments of collective energy from the band and crowd; The crowd shouted "Inspiration!" right on cue at the start of Terrapin [7][9]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer says the Rhythm Devils' drum segment thunders on this recording [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **My Favorite Things**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [12]

## The recordings

- **DeadCo2019-11-08.travitz.schoepsCMC64v.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 194 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [1]
- **deadandcompany2019-11-08.neumann_skm140.sunboy.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 196 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **deadco2019-11-08**: source not stated; 19 songs; 195 min [4]
- **deadco2019-11-08.DeadCo2019-11-08Hampton-Coliseum**: audience recording; 19 songs; 187 min [5]. Said about its sound: The recording cuts out during The Days Between because the taper's battery ran out [5]

## Around the show

- Lineup listed: Mickey Hart, Bill Kreutzmann, Bob Weir, Oteil Burbridge, Jeff Chimenti and John Mayer [2]
- Reviewer describes an energized crowd pushing the band along [8]
- Reviewer's first Dead show was at Hampton over 35 years ago; it was his wife's first show [9]
- Longtime listener ranks this among the finest Dead & Company shows he has heard [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **DeadCo2019-11-08.travitz.schoepsCMC64v.flac16**: taped by Jeff Travitz; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps CMC64v's>Grace Design Lunatec V3>Sound Devices 744t [1]. Also: Edited in Soundforge Pro 13 for fades and levels, split with CDWAV, converted to FLAC with Trader's Little Helper [1]
- **deadandcompany2019-11-08.neumann_skm140.sunboy.flac16**: taped by Steven Weld; transferred by Steven Weld; source: Neumann SKM140(AK40's/LC3's/KM100's)>GAKables xlr>Lunatec V2>GAKables xlr>Apogee Mini-Me@24/96>AES/EBU>Sound Devices 722 @24bit/96kHz ~ [2]
- **deadco2019-11-08**: Taped at front of board, slightly right of center, DINa; downconverted to 16/44 via Audacity, then FLAC [4]
- **deadco2019-11-08.DeadCo2019-11-08Hampton-Coliseum**: taped by JT/NY; transferred by JT/NY; source: Aud > Nakamichi CM700's W CP703's > GAKable's > Sound Devices 722 @ 24/96 [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by original-concert-posters.com: [dead | Original Concert Posters](https://original-concert-posters.com/category/dead/) [13]
- Poster by www.abebooks.co.uk: [Dead and Company - 2019 - Fall Tour - Poster - Hampton, VA - Hampton Coliseum, Nov 8, 2019: Very Good (2019) 450 printed](https://www.abebooks.co.uk/Dead-Company-2019-Fall-Tour-Poster/32161173754/bd) [14]
